cover_note: Reschio è una tenuta privata nelle colline umbre attorno a un castello millenario con fattorie restaurate e trasformate dalla famiglia Bolza.

evidence.quote: Reschio is a 3,700 acres private estate in the Umbrian hills, centred around a thousand-year-old castle and a collection of over 50 farmhouses, many of which have now been restored and transformed.
it has been carefully revived over the past three decades by the Bolza family, architects, designers and custodians of the land
